title: The Prayer Wheel
text: A great wheel of prayers, taller than a man, turns slowly by the shrine path with a deep wooden groan. Each turn sends a prayer to the Six, the monks say. Its handles are worn to the shape of a thousand hands.

options.label: Each of you gives the wheel a turn.

outcomes.text: Prayers, and a lightness, and the wheel's groan in your chest.

options.label: The strongest spins it as hard as they can.

outcomes.text: A thousand prayers at once, and one of them answered.
It flies off its axle, and the monks will be talking about it for a while.
One of them is a prayer for your House, written long ago, in a hand you almost know.
